rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a product is unavailable because it is out of stock.

example.english: This phone case is currently unavailable.
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 sau2 gei1 hok3 ji4 gaa1 mou5 fo3

rows.note: Use this when a person is unavailable because they are busy or not free.

example.english: I’m unavailable today; I’ll get back to you tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我今日唔得閒，聽日先覆你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4 ting1 jat6 sin1 fuk1 nei5

rows.note: Use this for something that is not currently on hand or readily available, especially in more written or careful wording.

example.english: The relevant document is currently unavailable, so it cannot be provided immediately.
example.traditional: 有關文件暫時無手邊，未能即時提供。
example.jyutping: jau5 gwaan1 man4 gin6 zaam6 si4 mou4 sau2 bin1 mei6 nang4 zik1 si4 tai4 gung1
